prompt: Add a 'refer a friend for a cash bonus preview' feature: when someone signs up with a referral code, show the referrer a preview of their updated net worth including the bonus, before it's actually credited.

Shorts P&L is calculated wrong — it should be (avg - current) * qty when qty is negative too, but right now large short positions show a distorted number. Just fix the shortsPnl() calculation, nothing else about how shorts work.

The hand-typed STARS/NEWS/MOOD fallback data (used when the live worker is unreachable) only covers a subset of players. Extend buildDB()'s fallback-handling so that ANY player without curated STARS/NEWS/MOOD data still gets a reasonable synthetic performance/hype value instead of defaulting to flat/zero, using the same anchor-based notoriety scaling already used elsewhere in buildDB().

There's a bug where two users with the exact same net worth get assigned the same numeric rank on the leaderboard, so the rank numbers skip (e.g. two people tied at rank 3, then the next person is rank 5 instead of 4). Can you find and fix this?
